description: This file manages global counters for tracing and profiling, defining metadata for various counters, incrementing counters, updating final counters with thread safety considerations, and emitting counter values per thread and globally.

methods.name: void tr2_counter_increment(enum trace2_counter_id cid,uint64_t value)
methods.description: Increments a specific counter identified by its ID by a given value, marking the thread as having used any counter and, if applicable, per-thread counters.

methods.name: void tr2_update_final_counters(void)
methods.description: Aggregates per-thread counters into a global final counter block, assuming the caller holds the mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: void tr2_emit_per_thread_counters(tr2_tgt_evt_counter_t * fn_apply)
methods.description: Emits counters that are marked for per-thread reporting if they were used in the current thread.

methods.name: void tr2_emit_final_counters(tr2_tgt_evt_counter_t * fn_apply)
methods.description: Emits the globally accumulated counters from the final counter block, assuming the caller holds the necessary lock.

ctags.name: final_counter_block
ctags.pattern: /^static struct tr2_counter_block final_counter_block; \/* access under tr2tls_mutex *\/$/
